scripts.//_reproducible_prisma: CRITICAL — clean-checkout guard. Runs `prisma generate` from packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma before any typecheck/test/verify that depends on @prisma/client types. Without this step, downstream type errors would look like missing exports (models, LeadQueueStatus) or implicit-any fallbacks in packages/db/src/client.ts. Idempotent: regenerating from an unchanged schema is a no-op on the file system.

scripts.//_bai_sec_11: BAI-SEC-11 (2026-07-25) — CSP drift gate. Compares public/_headers and render.yaml against scripts/security-headers.mjs. Exits 1 on drift. Wire into CI before the build step.

scripts.//_bai_deploy_11: BAI-DEPLOY-11 (2026-07-25) — post-deploy gate. Compares live x-brightai-build header + /api/health/ JSON against local git HEAD. Exits 1 on drift. Use after every deploy.
scripts.//_bai_proc_12: BAI-PROC-12 (2026-07-25) — production content gate. Runs the FULL verify-post-deploy.mjs (drift + content: hreflang, forbidden paths, canonical, security headers). Use to prove a deploy is correct end-to-end.
scripts.//_bai_proc_12_reports: BAI-PROC-12 (2026-07-25) — CI gate for report/*.md files. Scans every report for the verified_production: yes field. Exits 1 if any report claims ✅ without verified_production=yes. Runs in reports-gate workflow.
scripts.//_bai_deploy_11_cf: BAI-DEPLOY-11 (2026-07-25) — Cloudflare cache purge. Required env: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID. --all by default, --files <path1> <path2>... for targeted.
scripts.//_bai_sec_11_hsts: BAI-SEC-11 (2026-07-25) — Cloudflare Transform Rule to inject Strict-Transport-Security on every response (completes the CSP source-of-truth posture on prerendered static pages; HSTS does not work in meta http-equiv). Required env: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID. Idempotent — no-op if the rule already matches. API only (no manual fallback per user direction).
